description: SEIS God Mode Command Center is a high-leverage local-demo operating surface that connects agent orchestration, language routing, production readiness, evidence, validation, rollback, and human approval without enabling unrestricted execution.

definition.meaning: Integrated development across multiple SEIS layers with explicit evidence, validation, rollback, and human review.
definition.notMeaning: Permission to bypass security, deploy automatically, expose secrets, execute untrusted code, rewrite the repository broadly, or merge without review.

layerLift.label: Product Experience
layerLift.evidence: Interactive local command center, mission planner, agent map, readiness board, and language router.

layerLift.label: Repository Governance
layerLift.evidence: Canonical JSON contract, demo guide, PR queue update, and human-gated rules.

layerLift.label: Agent Orchestration
layerLift.evidence: Nine-stage pipeline, eight specialist roles, deterministic handoffs, and dry-run mission plans.

layerLift.label: Automation and Quality
layerLift.evidence: Dedicated validator and GitHub Actions workflow with zero runtime dependencies.

layerLift.label: Cloud and Security
layerLift.evidence: Secrets, provider calls, SSH, deployment, database writes, and autonomous merge remain disabled.

layerLift.label: Knowledge System
layerLift.evidence: Every mission produces an exportable local JSON plan with checks, gates, and rollback notes.

operatingPrinciples: Connect implementation, documentation, validation, and handoff.
Use evidence instead of readiness claims.
Keep local-demo, planned, blocked, and approval-required states visually separate.
Prefer deterministic contracts before adding runtimes or dependencies.
Preserve rollback and user ownership at every stage.

agentPipeline.label: User Intent
agentPipeline.purpose: Capture the operator goal, constraints, priority, and desired outcome.
agentPipeline.evidence: Mission planner input and exported local plan.

agentPipeline.label: Research and Context
agentPipeline.purpose: Read repository contracts, docs, source files, validation history, and supplied references.

agentPipeline.label: Planning
agentPipeline.purpose: Create a narrow implementation sequence with checks, risks, and rollback.

agentPipeline.label: Architecture
agentPipeline.purpose: Define boundaries, data contracts, UI surfaces, APIs, and approval gates.
agentPipeline.evidence: Canonical JSON contracts and architecture docs.

agentPipeline.label: Language Router
agentPipeline.purpose: Choose the smallest language set that fits the layer, risk, validation path, and existing repository.
agentPipeline.evidence: Universal Language Atlas and Language Purpose Matrix.

agentPipeline.label: Execution
agentPipeline.purpose: Implement only the approved slice and preserve unrelated work.

agentPipeline.label: Review
agentPipeline.purpose: Check correctness, accessibility, security, maintainability, and truthful status labels.
agentPipeline.evidence: CI, CodeQL, security scan, and validator output.

agentPipeline.label: Handoff
agentPipeline.purpose: Summarize findings, changes, validation, residual risk, and the next best step.
agentPipeline.evidence: PR body, demo guide, and mission export.

agentPipeline.label: Human Gate
agentPipeline.purpose: Keep merge, deployment, credentials, external writes, and destructive actions under explicit owner control.
agentPipeline.evidence: Open PR and disabled live-action controls.

agentRoles.label: Research Agent
agentRoles.mission: Gather repository evidence, references, dependencies, and current state.

agentRoles.label: Planning Agent
agentRoles.mission: Turn goals into a narrow sequence, milestone map, and rollback plan.

agentRoles.label: Architecture Agent
agentRoles.mission: Own boundaries, contracts, data flow, and system tradeoffs.

agentRoles.label: Execution Agent
agentRoles.mission: Implement the approved slice without broad unrelated changes.

agentRoles.label: Review Agent
agentRoles.mission: Validate behavior, accessibility, quality, and honest status labels.

agentRoles.label: Security Agent
agentRoles.mission: Protect secrets, permissions, provider boundaries, and audit evidence.

agentRoles.label: DevOps Agent
agentRoles.mission: Prepare CI, deployment readiness, observability, and rollback without applying live changes.

agentRoles.label: Design System Agent
agentRoles.mission: Keep the experience coherent, accessible, responsive, minimal, and premium.

languageRouter.selectionRule: Use the smallest language set that matches the existing layer and validation path.

hardGates: No secrets, tokens, private keys, private endpoints, or credentials in the repository.
No live provider calls from frontend routes.
No SSH, deployment, DNS, firewall, or cloud spend without explicit approval.
No external database writes without schema, auth, migration, privacy, and rollback approval.
No compiler, interpreter, SDK, engine, model, or dependency installation without a scoped reason.
No autonomous merge, release, branch deletion, history rewrite, or destructive cleanup.
No production-readiness claim without matching validation evidence.
